scope: Python runtime modules under core plus public top-level facades
review_policy: The local quality suite enforces these limits; GitHub CI is disabled. runtime_lines is 19250 to cover path-safe, non-overwriting artifact backups, atomic job/lane recovery, bounded resume attempts, blocking multi-agent approval when executable commands are hidden, preserving valid Telegram HTML while splitting rendered messages, collision-safe task workspace allocation, cleanup after failed task ownership registration, strict receipt schema typing, cron retry after transient scheduler errors, named invalid integer settings, current DeepSeek model defaults with legacy ID migration, rejecting cron timestamps and intervals outside the supported localtime range in user input and stored jobs, confining acceptance-command working directories to their workspace while exposing the cwd in approval previews, skipping voice downloads when transcription is unconfigured, chunking long approval previews with action buttons on the final reviewed chunk, confining acceptance file, handoff, and glob checks to resolved workspace paths, and giving acceptance commands a minimal environment while disclosing their host access in approval and security documentation, scrubbing Git checkpoint environments, and rejecting artifact-workspace symlinks before resolving; revisit after removing comparable runtime code. Raising a limit requires an ADR or an explicit architecture-budget rationale in the same review.
